newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media -to June 15.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to June 15 ********* The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe. ********* MONDAY, MAY 19 LONDON - Marjorie Scardino, chief executive of Pearson Plc, addresses Advertising Association's Annual General Meeting luncheon. 1300 GMT.
